blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: The NIPUN Bharat Scheme aims to ensure every child, aged 3-9 years, achieves proficiency in
foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3. Launched by the Ministry of Education, it supports
Improve literacy and numeracy for young children.
Achieve proficiency in reading, writing, and numeracy by 2026-27.
Approach: Teacher capacity building, use of technology, and regular assessments.
The scheme aims to ensure quality early education and address disparities in learning.
